scope: One rendered page per paper inspected in four contact sheets; A04, R06, and R03 also inspected as individual full-page images. Not a full-document typography audit.

papers.D01: Caption above table; compact estimates and errors; detailed notes below; text resumes with economic discussion.
papers.D02: Local-polynomial curve and shaded interval; residualized axes; method and interval defined below plot.
papers.D03: Assumptions have introductory and interpretative prose; displays are integrated with derivation.
papers.D04: Named assumptions and proposition references; dense colored links and a long technical footnote warrant restraint in a reading draft.
papers.D05: Envelope explanation carried in prose, followed by a worked economic example.
papers.D06: Compact fit table; parenthesized errors and bracketed p-values; sample and controls in notes.
papers.A01: Readable author-manuscript body; numbered equations; theorem followed by explanatory prose.
papers.A02: Multi-case theorem in italics; long parameter ranges illustrate the cost of over-compact formal statements.
papers.A03: Results paragraphs interpret geographic patterns before cost-benefit operations; formulas remain inline where appropriate.
papers.A04: Two diagram panels separate directly and indirectly affected locations; arrows and labels explain stages but increase density.
papers.A05: No vertical table rules; units in labels; detailed clustering and measurement notes.
papers.A06: A central condition is displayed; successive paragraphs distinguish its implications.
papers.K01: Definition and proposition receive surrounding prose; central welfare formula is prominent but not boxed.
papers.K02: Figure discussion and subsection opening share an economic object; substantial secondary derivation in footnote.
papers.K03: Data/model curves use line and marker distinctions; small plotting area is not a universal inclusion-size recommendation.
papers.K04: Interpretation precedes the discussion heading; several technical footnotes occupy a substantial page fraction.
papers.R01: GMM estimates and parenthesized errors; uncertainty definition below table; interpretation in body text.
papers.R02: Identification discussion continues directly from the gravity equation; no decorative mathematical framing.
papers.R03: Nine-column table remains compact; mathematical row labels challenge scanning; notes define composite objects.
papers.R04: Price-index comparison proceeds in prose with references; display density varies with the section's task.
papers.R05: Four aligned spatial panels; separate scales and explicit truncation labels; publisher proof marks are not house-style choices.
papers.R06: Three maps with separate legends; missingness and denominators declared; long but substantive notes.
papers.R07: Outcome panels separate data and model variants; normalization and units differ across panels and are explained in notes.
